props.tagText: 25 YEARS EXPERIENCE • TAMPA BAY & CENTRAL FLORIDA
props.title: Industrial-strength garage epoxy & polyurea by
props.subtitle: 4x stronger than standard epoxy. Engineered with commercial polyaspartic topcoats that resist hot tire pick-up, UV yellowing, chemical spills, and heavy Florida moisture.

props.title: Commercial Diamond Grinding & Zero Peeling Formula
props.subtitle: Unlike DIY kits that bubble within 6 months, our multi-layer polyurea systems permanently bond directly into the concrete pores.

features.title: Diamond Grinding Prep
features.description: Every floor is mechanically ground with heavy industrial diamond planetary grinders to create the optimal CSP bonding profile.

features.title: 100% Hot-Tire Proof
features.description: High thermal resistance prevents tires from lifting the coating during humid Florida summer heat.

features.title: 1-Day Rapid Cure
features.description: Walk on your new floor within 6 hours and park your vehicles back inside the garage in only 24 hours.

props.title: Full-Service Residential & Commercial Concrete Solutions
props.subtitle: Choose from 57 designer flake blends, seamless metallic marbling, or heavy-duty commercial quartz.

services.title: Full Chip Flake Garage Flooring
services.description: Our most popular multi-layer system. Textured slip-resistant finish, hides concrete imperfections, and carries a lifetime warranty.

services.title: Patio & Lanai Polyurea Coatings
services.description: 100% UV-stable aliphatic polyaspartic coatings that will never fade, chalk, or amber under direct Florida sunshine.

services.title: Pool Deck Cool-Touch Coatings
services.description: Barefoot-friendly, slip-resistant pool surround restoration engineered to resist pool chlorine, salt, and mildew.

services.title: Designer Metallic Epoxy Floors
services.description: Flowing 3D marble and molten metal aesthetics ideal for man caves, showrooms, retail storefronts, and interior living spaces.

services.title: Commercial Kitchen & Warehouse Quartz
services.description: High-impact quartz broadcast systems built for extreme forklift traffic, anti-slip safety compliance, and aggressive chemical washing.
